verdict.rationale: Mollie Components (Mollie JS) lets developers add credit-card holder fields directly into their own checkout while staying PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant, so customers can enter card data without being redirected to a hosted page. The evidence covers only card fields and never describes styling or customization options. missing for 10: evidence of customization or styling of the embedded components, embedded support beyond credit-card fields (other payment methods), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Mollie JS is a set of Javascript APIs that allow you to add the fields needed for credit card holder data to your own checkout, in a way that is fully PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant.
Mollie Components (embeddable card components for PCI scope reduction)
